content: Received, but the dollar figures were stripped in transit ("+,944", "DD ,370") — resend as plain digits. To reproduce on the corrected engine (early-close fix in src/quant_futures/session_calendar.py, commit 6f75da7 — pull it if your engine predates it, otherwise your 2024-25 numbers inherit the dead-sleeve artifact), commit the exact rule dicts (instrument/family/lookback/threshold/stop_atr/target_r/hold_bars/session_start/session_end/trailing_atr/max_contracts) for MNQ Trend 1c, MES Mom 1c, MES Trend and MNQ MornBrk to a branch and push. Two cautions before anything is called a hold: a 1c trend rule on 2010-23 is the same family as the mass_v2 survivors (trend lb8 10-12 ET held with +$437/2y; the all-day regime rules flipped sign in 2025), so check its 2025 alone; and choosing which sleeves to combine (Duo vs Tri) after seeing 2024-25 is validation selection — register the pairing first, then look once. I'll re-run whatever you push on the fixed engine and report alongside the 1-min results (~1 h out).
